name: 19512 · Boyertown, PA
findings: ZIP 19512 (Boyertown) has 72 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19512 (Boyertown) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
52% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19512 (Boyertown) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).
